summary: 8/8 acceptance criteria exercised with backend tests + browser checks. 1 criterion (channels/search) blocked by missing seed data (agents, channels, store seed items, seed projects all empty in DB) — not a code defect in routes, but the app ships unusable until `python backend/seed.py` is run.

checks.criterion: Canais e busca degradam com segurança
checks.name: channels-search-safe
checks.evidence: Navigated to /canais: zero channel-card-* elements rendered (screenshot: channels-search-safe-failure.png) because GET /api/channels returns [] (curl http://localhost:8001/api/channels -> 200 '[]', confirming backend is healthy but has no seeded channel rows and there is no POST /channels endpoint to create one). The search panel lives inside the 'internet' ChannelCard, so it cannot be reached at all.

checks.criterion: Canais e busca degradam com segurança
checks.name: test_tscheck_channel_search.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/channels -> 200 '[]' (expected seeded whatsapp/facebook/internet channels per SPEC.md). test_channel_config_persists and test_channel_update_invalid_status_rejected fail because there is no channel row to PATCH. test_internet_search_degrades_safely (not dependent on seed) passed: POST /api/channels/internet/search -> 200, results=[] (DuckDuckGo search returned empty/failed gracefully per lib.search warning in backend logs — 'web_search failed').

bugs.title: Database has no seed data (agents, channels, store_items, projects all empty) — blocks Channels/Canais criterion end-to-end
bugs.evidence: curl http://localhost:8001/api/channels -> 200 '[]'; curl http://localhost:8001/api/agents -> 200 '[]'; mongo collections exist but are empty. SPEC.md documents expected seeds (5 agents, whatsapp/facebook/internet/visual/mcp channels, 4 is_sample store items, seed-project-aeropartz, seed-project-luna) and 'python backend/seed.py' to populate them (idempotent upsert, never run automatically on startup — no call to seed in server.py). Because /channels has no POST endpoint, the Canais page and its internet-search panel (nested inside the ChannelCard) cannot be reached or tested at all while the collection is empty.

action_items.item: seed_data_missing: run `cd /app/backend && python seed.py` (documented in SPEC.md as idempotent/non-destructive) to populate agents, channels, store_items and seed projects before the Canais/Channels criterion (and ideally the Cockpit hierarchy/store preview cards, which currently render with no data) can be fully verified.
